violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Yellow rice (45F) observed in 2 Dr UR, employee stated items were just moved out of unit to clean interior.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Rice discarded

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: Steak addition for ‘Greens’ section on pub menu.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. Please provide updated menu to EHS.

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: observed raw chicken and shrimp thawing in a container of water in the prep sink.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. Sink faucet turned on to have continuous water running on food items to thaw.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter. Observed wiping cloths in solution of sanitizer less than 150ppm quaternary ammonium.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. Sanitizer replaced.

violations.title: Hot Water Sanitizing Temperature Met
violations.observation: Due to improper operation of the hot water, mechanical warewashing machine, the thermolabel did not turn black, indicating that food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils are not being adequately sanitized. Dish plate thermometer observed between 142F-158F in dish machine.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Repair the dishmachine so that a thermolabel will turn black. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the 3 vat sink to manually wash, rinse and chemically sanitize food-contact surfaces. Dishes will be taken upstairs to functional dish machine. Please provide repair to EHS.
